narrative.overview: SupermailBox is an Operate-mode product surface: disciplined, compact, and calm under operational pressure. Its warm mineral ground and white working planes keep dense records approachable, while graphite text and restrained sage states make the current action obvious without marketing-style spectacle. The interface behaves like a well-run desk rather than a passive report. Action queues lead; metrics and funnels support decisions. Plain-language labels, contact facts, recommended next steps, and progress checklists reduce interpretation work. Decoration is subordinate to scanability, recoverability, and accessible repeated use.
keyCharacteristics: Warm mineral canvas with crisp white work surfaces.
Sage is the single interaction accent; semantic colors communicate real state.
Dense ledgers, tables, and hairline divisions preserve information without visual noise.
Actions stay close to the person, record, or state they affect.
Lucide-style line icons and tabular numerals provide a consistent operational vocabulary.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Sage carries interaction and selection; do not introduce another decorative accent.

rules.name: The Semantic Honesty Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red appear only when the underlying state earns that meaning.

rules.name: The Plain Language Rule
rules.body: Prefer “User status,” “Sales stage,” and “Recommended next step” over internal system terminology or abbreviations.

rules.name: The Queue Before Report Rule
rules.body: The first working viewport must answer “what needs action now?” before it explains aggregate performance.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Do not add ambient card shadows to ordinary panels; use a hairline border and material contrast first.

dos: Do lead repeated-use screens with the next operational action.
Do use plain-language sentence-case labels and short explanatory copy.
Do keep contact details, plan, user status, interest, sales stage, and follow-up visible near the person.
Do use tabular numerals for metrics, scores, and counts.
Do provide 44px mobile targets and visible keyboard focus.
Do remove nonessential transitions and drawer animation when reduced motion is requested.
donts: Don't turn the interface into a grid of equal KPI cards with no action hierarchy.
Don't use forced all-caps labels, decorative gradients, glass effects, or promotional illustration in operational surfaces.
Don't use semantic colors as decoration or rely on color alone to communicate state.
Don't hide critical contact or account facts behind additional navigation.
Don't add shadows to ordinary panels when a border and tonal layer are sufficient.
